Note: Determine total pounds of concrete required based on
number of posts required. Divide by 60 or 80 lb. bag.
Figures based on 4x4 hole=10", 5x5 hole=12", both 30" deep.

crop.sha256: <computed at render time; no crop exists for this element today>

source_refs._note: The majority case. A clean text-layer paragraph with a bbox and no pre-cut crop — the crop must be rendered on demand. docs/curation/02-curation-schema.md §2.11 verified that a crop of this page's paragraph bbox renders exactly the three lines containing 30" deep, which is what confirmed the origin and scale. Note also the substance: this is an installation manual stating a footing depth, and under the shipped source policy an installation manual is not an admissible source for a structural parameter. The source ref resolves regardless; admissibility is decided at resolution, not here.

source_refs._note: Real reading, real crop hash, real reader. Two findings the frontend and the review queue both need to know: (1) the reading has NO cell box in crop pixels, because the readers that produced the 1,225 rows in table_read_candidates record row and column labels only. So a reviewer can be shown the crop but not the cell inside it, which is exactly what docs/curation §2.5.3 requires and does not yet exist. Producing that box is the first concrete gap this design surfaces in our own store. (2) reader_kind is 'agent' for all 1,225 rows — there is not one human reading in this corpus, and the review_status 'cross_family_verified' means two agents agreed, not that a person looked.

source_refs._note: The trap. The filename contains the word 'current' and the document is superseded — on the strong basis that a later NOA names it as a previous approval. It also still carries an expiration date of 2029, three years away, so 'not expired' and 'not current' are both true at once. This is the shape of the failure recorded in rationale.md §1: a promoted structural value backed by a superseded approval. Any interface that shows expiration_date without version_status_basis reproduces it.

source_refs._note: The 72-dpi case. Six documents in the corpus are CAD PNGs with no PDF at all, so there is nothing to render — the page image IS the source file, passed through. pages.width/height are PIXELS here, not points, and the arithmetic only works because 72/72 = 1; an implementation that hardcodes 200 dpi produces a crop 2.8x too large and off the page. Note also the honesty: the quoted dimension string is at 14% OCR confidence on a page averaging 32%. It is exactly the kind of value a person must look at rather than trust, which is what this endpoint is for.

params.detail: derived evidence can never reach curation level 2

source_refs._note: A large share of the richest material in this repo — post reinforcement specs, gate hardware load ratings, racking capacities, profile dimensions — lives in hand-researched data/structural/*.json rather than in any extractable document region. It is real knowledge and it is addressable, and it has no picture. The interface must render this record as an honest 'no image, and here is why' rather than a broken thumbnail or a 404. docs/curation/02-curation-schema.md §2.5.3 rules that derived evidence can never be accepted; this record is what that rule looks like at the boundary.
